user_query: I'm planning a game night with my friends and we want to try out some new games. Can you recommend some free games available on the Epic Games Store? Also, provide me with the current store status list from Evosis's Game Database to check if any of the games are currently on sale.

TaskList.description: Query the Epic Games Store for a list of free games.
Fetch the current store status list from Evosis's Game Database.
Filter the free games retrieved in Step 1 to check against the sale status from Step 2.
